items: Have a piece of parchment paper in air frying basket
Cut salmon into approximately 6-8 oz portions
Give each piece a small coating of olive oil and place skin side down on parchment paper (if skinless, coat a bit extra of the bottom with oil to stick less)
Sprinkle brown sugar generously (can layer chili powder and brown sugar if desired)
Put in air fryer for 10-12 min
I found I like more chili powder than expected to balance out the brown sugar.
Take the fish off when warm/hot or it sticks to the parchment more.
Use a thermometer and take it out at 140; it will cook to the 145 safety mark while getting plates, etc., so it's not overdone.
